description: This source file implements the VertexDataManager class, which manages vertex buffer data translation, including static, dynamic, and direct storage, for rendering in a Direct3D context within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: TranslatedAttribute
classes.description: Represents a translated vertex attribute, including its storage, offset, and buffer information.

classes.name: VertexDataManager
classes.description: Manages vertex data translation and buffer management for rendering.

classes.name: VertexBufferBinding
classes.description: Encapsulates a reference to a vertex buffer object, managing its lifetime and binding state.

methods.name: computeOffset
methods.description: Calculates the byte offset for a vertex attribute based on the start vertex.

methods.name: ClassifyAttributeStorage
methods.description: Determines whether a vertex attribute uses static, dynamic, direct, or current value storage.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the VertexDataManager, setting up the streaming buffer.

methods.name: deinitialize
methods.description: Resets and clears the VertexDataManager resources.

methods.name: prepareVertexData
methods.description: Prepares vertex attributes for rendering, handling static, dynamic, direct, and current value data.

methods.name: StoreDirectAttrib
methods.description: Stores a direct attribute, referencing the buffer directly.

methods.name: StoreStaticAttrib
methods.description: Stores a static attribute, copying data into a static buffer.

methods.name: storeDynamicAttribs
methods.description: Stores dynamic attributes into streaming buffers.

methods.name: PromoteDynamicAttribs
methods.description: Promotes dynamic attributes to static buffers after data transfer.

methods.name: reserveSpaceForAttrib
methods.description: Reserves buffer space for an attribute before data transfer.

methods.name: storeDynamicAttrib
methods.description: Stores a single dynamic attribute into the streaming buffer.

methods.name: storeCurrentValue
methods.description: Stores a current value attribute into a buffer, updating if changed.
